question: Who are our top customers by total spend?
sql:
SELECT oi.user_id AS customer_id,
       u.country,
       COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders,
       ROUND(SUM(oi.sale_price), 2) AS total_spend
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN users AS u ON u.id = oi.user_id
WHERE oi.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
GROUP BY customer_id, u.country
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 10
report: Customers are always identified by customer ID, never by name or contact details. Report total spend together with the number of orders, because a single very large order and a loyal repeat buyer call for different actions.
